title: National-security artificial-intelligence research institutes
last_action: Enacted in the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026.
summary: Authorizes Defense Department AI research institutes that may maintain secure and privacy-protected datasets, develop predeployment testbeds, conduct national-security AI research, and provide compute and technical support.
committee_dynamics: The authority was enacted through the FY2026 defense authorization vehicle.
